captions.detailed: An open-frame motion study mechanism consisting of a vertical grey central post secured to a dark rectangular base. Mounted on this post are two independent arm assemblies, each rotating via a collar hub sandwiched between dark rings. The upper arm is bright orange with a fork-shaped end effector, while the lower arm is dark blue with a flat, circular pad at its tip. Each arm functions as an independent revolute joint, allowing full rotation around the central vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a two-branch motion study mechanism. It should feature a grounded vertical central post on a rectangular base, supporting two independent rotating arms on collar hubs. The upper arm must be orange with a fork-shaped tip, and the lower arm must be blue with a round pad tip, with both arms modeled as revolute joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a grounded base and a vertical cylinder for the central post. It then defines two independent arm links: an upper arm and a lower arm. Each arm is composed of a central collar (a cylinder bounded by two thin disk rings) and an extended arm body. The upper arm body is extruded with a fork-shaped tip, while the lower arm body features a circular pad. Finally, two revolute joints are defined using the central post as the parent and each respective arm as the child, aligned with the vertical Z-axis.
